params.name: mode
params.description:
Define the mode for the result output. Mode options:
  * `compact` - Shows only the names of the algos
  * `detailed` - Shows all metadata of the algos

items.docs:
The request delivers all available algos for the selected customer as a list of strings.
Users are only able to access their own algos but not other users'.

items.docs:
The request creates a new algo with the specified parameters. If the algo already exists, an update is performed on the existing algo.
The algo content has to be added to the request body in yaml format.
A detailed description about how to create algos and the required content can be found in the Algo Creation Manual.

params.name: owner
params.description: Username of the owner of the algo.

params.name: marketId
params.description:
Unique market identifier code as specified in ISO 10383 on T7.
Please note: 'marketId' parameter is MANDATORY for running algos on T7 instruments

params.name: exchange
params.description:
Unique exchange identifier on CME.
Please note: 'exchange' parameter is MANDATORY for running algos on CME instruments

params.name: date
params.description: Trading day in the format  YYYYMMDD.

params.name: marketSegmentId
params.description:
Unique product identifier or product pool identifier on T7.
Please note: 'marketSegmentID' parameter is MANDATORY for running algos on T7 instruments

params.name: asset
params.description:
Unique asset identifier on CME.
Please note: 'asset' parameter is MANDATORY for running algos on CME instruments

params.name: additional
params.description:
The query string of this endpoint can also be used to specify additional algo specific parameters. The parameters just have to be added with `&` to the query.
The following rules apply: * `name=value` is used to specify a parameter.
Example: level=1 * `&` is used to combine multiple parameters with a logical AND.
Example: aggr=4&level=1 To test the feature in this document, please add the parameters in a valid JSON object.
Example: {"aggr":4,"level":1}

items.docs: The request runs the specified algo and returns the result data.
